data.title: Performing Arts Program Draws Strong Turnout in Dammam
data.content:
Riyadh, November 22, 2026, SPA -- The Theater and Performing Arts Commission concluded the second stop of its public performing arts program in Dammam. The four-day event saw a strong turnout and active participation from all age groups.
    The program drew families, youth, and children, who gathered to enjoy theatrical shows and traveling performances, fostering an interactive atmosphere that brought artists and performers together with the public in various open, shared spaces.
    The high level of public attendance reflects the community’s keen interest in theater and the performing arts. It also underscores the importance of presenting these art forms in public spaces, providing diverse cultural and artistic experiences for all segments of society.
    The performances will continue to tour across several regions of the Kingdom until December 19, 2026.
    -- SPA
